entries.title: Task Wizard
entries.description: New structured task wizards help you create comprehensive research queries and class plans. Click the task buttons above the chat input to get started.

entries.title: What's New Feature
entries.description: Stay updated with the latest features and improvements. Click the bell icon to see recent updates.

entries.title: AI Model Selection
entries.description: You can now choose the underlying AI model that generates the answers. Different models have different strengths - some are faster, others more thorough. Experiment to find which works best for your needs.
